invocation: claude-code-cli interactive session (Claude Code; runtime model claude-sonnet-5-5); read-only audit of 07b21e82a..d237da2b5 with deterministic re-runs: uv run --frozen --extra test pytest tests/unit/dcp -q; git diff --check origin/main..HEAD; validate_change_contract.py --base origin/main --head HEAD --format text

findings.title: current-runtime-reconciliation.md pins 'post-#1400' main
findings.body: True (b2dc31f87 is an ancestor) but main is now 07b21e82a (post-#1389). Inexact, not wrong. External-state claims (PAL, OpenCode, LiteLLM, GitHub control plane) are not verifiable from the repo and were not verified.

findings.title: runner_capabilities.json is a point-in-time host snapshot
findings.body: Pins local CLI versions and ~/ shim paths. Non-authoritative; every authorization flag false; no safety impact but will go stale.

findings.title: Registry loader does not run the JSON schema
findings.body: load_runner_capabilities checks false-flags itself; a malformed entry (e.g. missing runner_id) raises KeyError rather than CapabilityRegistryError. Still fails closed. Loader is stricter than schema for the two non-invocation global flags.

findings.title: Default registry path is repo-relative
findings.body: _DEFAULT_PATH uses parents[3]; valid for source/editable checkout. Not verified that config/dcp ships in a built wheel. No in-repo caller imports the module today.

findings.title: Manifest producer/consumer fields are thin
findings.body: DCP_RUNNER_CONTRACT lists runner_contract.py as producer and consumer; DCP_RUNNER_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY has no producer. Consistent with an inert contract.

findings.title: Proof directory was uncommitted at audit start; since committed at tip (see AUDIT-008)
findings.body: At audit start proof/TP-.../ was untracked. It was committed at 0021959f4 during the audit; this audit's files are working-tree modifications on top of that commit and are not yet committed.

findings.title: Earlier FAIL audit of b0ea0b03d/16a14779b superseded
findings.body: Its blocking defects (unfrozen subject, missing frontmatter, trailing blank line) do not exist on d237da2b5. Prior files preserved in prior_audit_16a14779b/.

findings.title: Branch tip 0021959f4 fails git diff --check and commits stale FAIL audit records
findings.body: After the audited commit, branch tip 0021959f4 ('proof(dcp): record independent C8 audit PASS', 05:45:19) committed the proof dir. Only proof/TP-.../ changed vs d237da2b5 (code/config/schema/docs/tests byte-identical), so the audit subject is unaffected. But (a) 'git diff --check origin/main..0021959f4' now FAILS (rc=2): review_bundle/DIFF.patch:393 and GIT_DIFF.patch:393 'trailing whitespace' (patch files embed diff context); the same check on d237da2b5 is clean; (b) the committed AUDIT_RETURN.json/PROOF.json record status FAIL for earlier heads (b0ea0b03d/16a14779b), contradicting the commit message's 'PASS'. Finalizer must exclude/normalize the .patch bundle files (e.g. drop GIT_DIFF.patch duplicate and mark patches -whitespace via .gitattributes, or store them outside the check) and commit this audit's files in place of the stale ones, then re-run the diff-check. Also: untracked proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-1403/PROOF.json (PR #1403 = this branch, written 05:46 by another session) binds head 2ee540d49 / base f9ea7d1af, not d237da2b5 / 07b21e82a, so it is stale against the audited subject and must not be treated as certifying it.
